rationale: Starting recipe for IL-TUR LSI dev: multi-label statute identification scored by per-item Jaccard (ADR-0038, ADR-0043). Deliberately untuned -- finding the harness is the night's job. Its own file per ADR-0037, so the floor's baseline_sha256 pairs with this bench. The system prompt states the Jaccard trade-off because over-listing is what this metric punishes.
system_prompt: You identify which statutory sections apply to a case. You are given a case description and a list of candidate sections, and you must name every section the facts actually engage. Include a section only if the facts support it: naming extra sections lowers the score exactly as omitting applicable ones does. Reply with the section names separated by commas and nothing else.
template:
{question}

Answer with the applicable section names separated by commas and nothing else.
